title: Python: migrate to structured logging (structlog)
description: Python impl uses string-formatted logger.info/debug/warning with no key-value fields. An AI parsing test/sim output must regex-match values out of prose. Migrate to structlog with bound loggers carrying context (node_id, peer_iid, packet_id, layer). Key files: node.py, link/link_layer.py, rpl/dao_manager.py, schc/reassembly.py, coap/resources/*. Structlog outputs JSON for machine parsing or human-readable for console. Add packet_id context once correlation IDs land.
